captions: “Just this one,” you said. Six times.
4:41 p.m. Your coffee went cold an hour ago.
Your prayer mat is rolled up in the bottom drawer.
Then the window turns orange. The sun is going down.
Asr is slipping away. And nobody here would notice.
Cold water on your wrists. Your chest slows down.
Four rak'ahs. Seven minutes. The emails were still there.

Now, before Maghrib: close the laptop. Pray Asr. The emails will still be there.
